chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi and C2 successfully manipulate Ritter by faking Shen Feizhi's death using photoshopped evidence, causing Ritter to believe his plan is succeeding. Gu Suizhou, struggling with the separation and the emotional toll of his parents' (Gu Lang and Lin Zizhuo) cremation, maintains his cover while secretly working to undermine Ritter. Shen Feizhi reveals he had already rescued the remains of Gu Suizhou's parents from Ritter's hospital. The chapter concludes with Gu Suizhou, overwhelmed by anxiety and longing, seeking comfort in a Pheromone Storage Sphere while Ritter remains oblivious to the trap closing in on him.
